2609.02343.title: SonicCaps: Large-Scale Diverse and Fine-Grained Captioning for Improved Audio-Retrieval
2609.02343.paper_summary: Recent advances in audio-language modeling have been driven by large-scale audio captioning datasets. However, existing datasets remain limited by low semantic diversity, generic descriptions lacking acoustic details, and one-to-one audio-caption mappings that poorly reflect the inherent ambiguity of auditory perception. We introduce SonicCaps, a large-scale audio captioning dataset comprising ~15M captions paired with ~700k audio clips, generated using a multi-modal large language model (Qwen3-Omni) conditioned on both audio and text. To explicitly promote diversity, we generate around 24 captions per audio via structured prompt engineering and few- shot generation, spanning main descriptions, rephrased variants (verbosity, style) and semantic tags. Human evaluation shows that SonicCaps is rated significantly higher than existing captioning datasets, with fine-grained analyses indicating that our captions are perceived as more descriptive and precise, which strongly correlates with quality judgments. Finally, training CLAP models on SonicCaps with a multi-caption sampling strategy consistently improves audio retrieval and zero-shot classification, with stronger generalization across public and commercial benchmarks. We release both SonicCaps and two specialized CLAP models on hugging face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zineb/SonicCaps.
2609.02343.paper_summary_zh: 最近在音頻語言建模方面的進展是由大規模音頻標註數據集推動的。<lb/>然而，現有數據集仍然受到低語義多樣性、缺乏聲學細節的通用描述以及一對一音頻-標註映射的限制，這些映射無法很好地反映聽覺感知的固有模糊性。<lb/>我們介紹了SonicCaps，一個大規模音頻標註數據集，包含約1500萬個標註，與約70萬個音頻片段配對，這些標註是使用一個多模態大型語言模型（Qwen3-Omni）生成的，該模型同時以音頻和文本為條件。<lb/>為了明確促進多樣性，我們通過結構化提示工程和少量生成方法，為每個音頻生成約24個標註，涵蓋主要描述、重述變體（冗長性、風格）和語義標籤。<lb/>人類評估顯示，SonicCaps的評分顯著高於現有的標註數據集，細緻的分析表明，我們的標註被認為更具描述性和精確性，這與質量評價有著強烈的相關性。<lb/>最後，在SonicCaps上訓練CLAP模型，採用多標註採樣策略，持續改善音頻檢索和零-shot分類，並在公共和商業基準上實現更強的泛化能力。<lb/>我們在hugging face上發布了SonicCaps和兩個專用的CLAP模型：https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zineb/SonicCaps。
